verdict.rationale: Customer.io's core product is workflow automation ('automations'/journeys) that trigger autonomously on events or segment membership and run continuously without manual intervention (docs-12, docs-30, docs-18), and the AI agent layer adds recurring scheduled autonomous tasks like deliverability reports and segment audits (docs-33) plus MCP/CLI access to list and manage automations (docs-9, docs-26, docs-27). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of automation reliability at scale (community evidence only touches an unrelated outage and pricing complaints, not automation failures).
